title: Customizations
description: V19 — From V18: "Customizations" panel as a zebra-striped tree table with collapsible groups and a workspace sub-page for workspace-scoped skills, instructions, agents and hooks. Manage has one nav grouped by domain: Agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex landing pages, Chat & Agents settings, Environments), Workbench (settings categories plus Extensions) and General (Commonly Used, Privacy, Modified, Managed…), with cross-links from agents and Extensions to their related settings. The embedded Settings prototype uses the same minimal flat rows as the other pages. Remotes → Environments as a compact table. Per-agent Models page matched to the live Language Models editor (search and filters in the shared top bar, Add Models / Install Model Providers, provider groups, hide/show, cost in credits per 1M tokens, model warnings, provider status).
